The alert-state and corrected-comment persistence observations were made by Root through authenticated GitHub reads; this reviewer inspected the retained results and their source-bound accuracy, without repeating API calls or tests. Old hosted CI is atcc62682, not at reviewed sourceb0b5358 or any final acceptance revision. The accepting integrator must wait for and independently check the final exact-main unit/integration/types/lint/CodeQL/traceability jobs and fresh post-scan open-alert state before posting acceptance. Loopback protocol fixtures and deterministic SHA indices do not establish real mailbox/provider/installation or production security. No blanket product-security, user-journey, release or deployment acceptance is claimed. Private findings and credentials are not copied.
